name: Mercury IO Mastercard

apr.notes: No interest is charged; balances are repaid automatically from Mercury accounts (daily, or 30-day terms once balances reach $15K).

credit_required.notes: Exclusively for Mercury business account holders; the credit limit is based on balances held with Mercury and linked accounts.

rewards.redemption_notes: Cashback is deposited automatically into the Mercury account after the balance is paid.

notes: Business charge card issued by Patriot Bank, N.A. for Mercury. An international transaction fee applies to non-USD transactions; the rate is not stated, so fx is null. No Mastercard network package is stated, so network_tier is none.
